# Pull Request

## What & why

## Documentation gate (Documentation-First)

- [ ] This change implements an **Approved** document: <link>
- [ ] No business rule was invented in code — every rule traces to a doc
- [ ] New decisions were recorded (module `decisions.md` / `DECISION_LOG.md` / ADR)
- [ ] `STATUS.md` updated if the state of work changed
- [ ] Indexes updated (`docs/modules/_INDEX.md`, ADR `_INDEX.md`) if applicable
